coupler_034.name: COUPLER-034
coupler_034.desc: Bolts the arm servos to the core. Every strike lands heavier; the core runs thin.

governor_207.name: GOVERNOR-207
governor_207.desc: A plated governor for the spine. It keeps the body standing a little longer.

regulator_000.name: REGULATOR-000
regulator_000.desc: The Warden's own regulator, still ticking after its heart stopped.

restore_module.name: RESTORE MODULE
restore_module.desc: A cache core small enough to carry. It keeps one copy of her, and only one.

cerement_112.name: CEREMENT-112
cerement_112.desc: Grave-cloth bound in steel thread. It held something that did not want to stay down.

pall_090.name: PALL-090
pall_090.desc: The velvet from the bier. It remembers the weight of the dead and gives some back.

tether_06.name: TETHER-06
tether_06.desc: Restraint straps from the kennel. Every buckle has a socket for spare parts.
